At the W38 close, proxy breadth remains weak and ETH-relative strength does not achieve sustained transmission through midcaps, small caps, and microcaps. Broad altseason remains inactive unless participation broadens beyond ETH and isolated large caps and survives pullbacks.
W38 ends as an unresolved, volatile consolidation or pullback phase rather than a confirmed broad risk-expansion regime or confirmed market breakdown.
